metadata.title: M365CustomerKeyOnboarding
metadata.description: The M365 Customer Key Onboarding PowerShell module is now generally available. Support for this module is available to all tenants, except for government tenants. To get started, follow the onboarding process outlined at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/customer-key-set-up.
